purpose: runtime identity contract for Qwen3.5-4B DFlash two-pass chunk-GDR rollback with the original GDR effective-length ABI and optional Target-only W8A8 dynamic quantization configured by the original inference YAML; incremental three-OM DFlash with one compact Draft / optional fourth ordinary decode and Python/C++ single-window msprof diagnostics; optional GDR MTP bank-select verification in Torch-NPU direct inference and incremental AIR/OM/C++

package_layout.hiai_source_policy: repository-distributed direct Tensor ABI integration; validated before weight loading and never patched at runtime
package_layout.hiai_output_abi: ordinary Tensor logits; feature-enabled tuple(logits, dflash_features)
package_layout.hiai_bridge_policy: retains the full-prefix oracle and provides persistent rollback with block-aligned real-token prompt chunks, scalar committed GDN state, at most 16 original-GDR chunk verify rows, accepted+1 second chunk state commit from the same round-start state by default, or native MTP verify with compact FP32 bank-slot selection, Torch conv prefix golden, provisional paged-KV writes, one logical commit cursor, atomic state publication, same-stream ordering without per-call host barriers, and optional Target-only W8A8 conversion plus per-current-block INT8 embedding/FP32 scale dequantization configured by the original inference YAML
package_layout.npu_policy: keep the HIAI target in models/ and install the complete DFlash package in models/dflash_v1/

dflash_reference.algorithm: DFlash V1 draft proposal and strict-greedy Target verification; this package replaces historical-prefix replay with a persistent transactional rollback receiver

target_checkpoint.runtime_policy: exact pinned config preferred; semantic Qwen3.5-4B config variants are accepted and reported, while target weight identity remains external

v1_runtime.draft_cache_contract: request-local six-layer committed K/V; append only new projected Target features, expose the current block transiently, crop on success, abort without mutating committed state, and construct only incremental RoPE positions

npu_embedded_runtime.hiai_runtime_policy: legacy ModelOutput sidecar compatibility only; direct HIAI Tensor/tuple source must not import it
npu_embedded_runtime.target_quant_policy: the CLI mirrors inference.py with --config and --quant_mode enable; the packaged original utils conversion is fail-closed and every pre-conversion nn.Linear path must become the original HIAI QLinear with exact K-by-N shape/device buffers; Draft-facing embedding and LM head remain FP16; every prompt chunk, decode row, and verify block indexes the YAML-declared INT8 embedding and FP32 scale artifacts

verification_routes.mtp_input_bank: FP32[B,T,H,Dk,Dv], T=K+1 in 1..16, INT8[B] input selector zero
verification_routes.mtp_commit: compact clone of output bank slot a; no second GDR; FP32 recurrent state
verification_routes.ordinary_route: original Chunk with FP32 persistent recurrent state
verification_routes.validation: CPU native-interface shims and host transactions only; actual NPU validation pending

rollback_runtime.policy: persistent ordinary and DFlash sessions; prefill uses the original multi-token GDR route with 64-row real-token chunks, INT16[B] call-local effective length, and no padding commit; only the final real prompt row executes the LM head; default T=K+1 verification and accepted+1 scalar state commit reuse the original chunk GDR from the same round-start state and do not require GDR-MTP; --verify-gdr mtp selects native MTP once per layer, seeds a T-slot FP32 bank with INT8 input-slot zero, and commits compact copies of bank slot a with FP32 recurrent state preserved across rounds; zero acceptance commits anchor and continues speculation in both routes; missing native MTP fails before loading weights; optional Target W8A8 reuses the original QLinear while the Draft stays FP16; incremental Draft KV cache; no historical-prefix replay during verify; strict-greedy zero token mismatch gate unchanged; ordinary and both verification routes initialize, retain and transfer recurrent state as FP32 without FP16 writeback

npu_benchmark.policy: strict-greedy gate before timing; original main inference.py and both rollback modes use an equal 32-token budget; quantized ordinary and DFlash use the exact same original YAML and resolved artifacts; rollback ordinary remains the scheduler-control baseline; rollback prefill uses block-aligned real-token chunks and rollback verify/accepted+1 commit defaults to two original-GDR chunk calls, with --verify-gdr mtp selecting native MTP and compact FP32 bank selection; separate ordinary/dflash processes; synchronized unprofiled 3+10 baseline; cumulative counters separated from resettable session state; copied-source content identity without VCS metadata; msprof diagnostic only with MSTX disabled by default and explicit opt-in; no CPU fallback; native msprof dynamic CLI single-stage and all-stage diagnostics with one loaded application, independent fresh-state warmups and one acknowledged window per stage; verify collects the first Chunk or unique MTP pass; accept-commit captures the accepted+1 second Chunk pass or MTP bank selection even at zero acceptance; decode-round collects the complete selected route; per-window GDR verify/commit layer counters, MTP state-selection counters when selected, and nonempty operator exports are required; separate raw directories and synchronized timing CSV; no pyACL and no formal latency or strict-greedy accuracy claim from stage diagnostics; ordinary Python and C++ prefill/decode/all windows; C++ DFlash prefill/draft/fused-verify/all windows; native C++ socket barriers and standard-library Python controller; actual graph-call counts checked; no device-performance claim from host fixtures; shared per-stage operator type/task reports grouped by input/output dtype, device/model and original CSV; general OM profiling entry prepares a fresh mode-specific plan from the selected deployment manifest

incremental_om_framework.validation: host fixture evidence only; real TorchAir/ATC, native ordinary parity and Ascend310P timing pending
incremental_om_framework.verification_policy: explicit verify_gdr chooses Verify; ordinary/Chunk/MTP all preserve FP32 recurrent cache; conv/KV and Draft remain FP16; Torch-NPU selects route without OM compilation

length_benchmark.policy: one ordinary baseline per prompt/output budget across all Draft/Verify combinations; external baseline path requires exact matching inputs, OM ABI/hashes, runtime and repeat counts; defaults 1 warmup + 3 measurements; always-on speculation; allowed output differences and drift remain recorded

long_context_prompts.policy: six Chinese-language tasks (including English-to-Chinese translation) and six English-language tasks; complete prompts without truncation or repetition padding; runtime records actual input_tokens and checks input plus output against capacity

length_benchmark.selection: --draft-quantization fp16 w4a16 w8a16; --verify-gdr chunk|mtp|both; --prompt-group all|short|long; --include-builtin-prompts merges prompt selections with offline dataset files; --ordinary-baseline reuses identity-checked saved ordinary batches without rerunning
length_benchmark.timing_output: sum measured decode-loop time ratios for ordinary/DFlash, matched Draft and Verify comparisons; prefill excluded; missing or zero decode timing is N/A; generation throughput retains prefill + decode; phase and graph timings reported separately

incremental_om_framework.common_reuse: export-air --draft-quantizations fp16 w4a16 w8a16 --verify-gdr both and compile-om produce seven unique OMs in one directory; shared prefill/decode and per-route verify compile once; six manifests select one Draft and one Verify

draft_execution.prefill: single_draft16_64_gears; ceil(input_tokens/64)-1 discarded-proposal preparation calls; final block in first useful Draft; no second Draft OM
draft_execution.selection: valid_rows > 16 selects gear 64; otherwise gear 16; one symbolic features axis and CANN finite dynamic_dims
draft_execution.validation: CPU equivalence, symbolic graph capture and fake ACL scheduling only; real TorchAir/ATC and Ascend310P measurements pending
draft_execution.memory: reuse 64-row feature buffer and current/next KV banks; one mandatory CANN control buffer; physical gear weight/workspace/peak pending
draft_execution.projection_policy: packed K/V and gate/up weights replace originals; shared context/noise row projection; 32 logical Linear calls for six layers
draft_execution.cache_update: functional npu_scatter_nd_update on dense BHCD row view; INT32 unique head-row indices; no full-cache transpose
draft_execution.attention: query group/row folding, no materialized KV repeat; FP16 matmul operands and FP32 score/softmax unchanged
draft_execution.numerics: Matmul shape changes can alter rounding; expanded CPU GQA sample observed max abs 2.44e-4; original model gates retained; NPU token/acceptance/peak-memory checks pending

om_io_binding.scope: Prebound ping-pong descriptors for shared state banks. Dynamic Draft shares its CANN gear-control input; offline NZ uses static M16/M64 OMs sharing feature/state/output buffers.
om_io_binding.validation: Host fake-ACL equivalence only; real Ascend310P timing pending

draft_quantization_om.execution: group-128 compressed read-only runtime inputs; 99 dynamic gear dimensions; CANN WeightQuantBatchMatmulV2 by default, FP16 activation and INT8 codes, W4 unpacked transiently; AIR inserts built-in ND-to-NZ TransData for 310P; inner_precise=0; explicit dequant FP16 reference selectable
draft_quantization_om.validation: Host arithmetic/export tests pass. User receiver reports show runtime-weight NZ native W4/W8 compilation and full Draft measurements. Ordinary token parity remains FAIL under allow-output-differences; task quality, locked ten-run stability and peak memory are not established. Optional offline NZ constants have separate r37 results below.
draft_quantization_om.workflow: normal export-air / compile-om and benchmark_gdr_lengths.py; flat seven-OM directory; mixed builtin/offline tests; ordinary baseline path reuse

atc_compatibility.graph_lowering: weight-quant-nk-nz-weight-gn-scale-v3; fold weight transpose, insert real INT8 ND-to-NZ TransData; retain scale[K/128,N]
atc_compatibility.scope: Original group-128 A16W8 values, precision and flat compressed input ABI; no new NPU kernel
atc_compatibility.evidence: Receiver CANN 9.0.0 / Ascend310P: ND group-128 and per-channel vector-scale probes fail in NK and KN. Official matching-version registry chooses only WeightNz on 310P; IsCapable requires transpose_weight=true and FRACTAL_NZ.
atc_compatibility.validation: User receiver: native runtime INT8 ND-to-NZ route compiled and executed W4/W8 Draft. W8 profile contains 26 WeightQuant calls. This does not validate optional offline constants, ordinary token parity, or a locked ten-run performance gate.
atc_compatibility.probe: tools/probe_draft_matmul_atc.py --bits 4 8 --projection tiny --group-size 128 --weight-layout nk --weight-format nz; synthetic live packed weights and M16/64 gears; PASS is compilation only
atc_compatibility.recovery: New layout requires AIR re-export; compile-om --resume only reuses identity-matching completed matrix deployments
atc_compatibility.shape_validation: Typed TorchAir Tensor.set_meta snapshots resolve empty intermediate GE descriptors; known shape/dtype conflicts fail before rewiring
atc_compatibility.probe_boundary: Per-channel controls use one-dimensional scale[N]; grouped controls retain scale[K/128,N]. Diagnostic options cannot alter production grouping. Only K=128 single-group native linears use an equivalent per-channel vector.
atc_compatibility.weight_storage: INT8 logical[N,K] -> FRACTAL_NZ[ceil(K/32),ceil(N/16),16,32]; keep origin_shape[N,K] and format_for_int=29; public compressed buffers unchanged

offline_nz_prepack.converter: tools/pack_draft_weights_nz.py --manifest <existing W8 member manifest> --output-dir <new run directory>
offline_nz_prepack.activation: export-air --draft-weight-prepack-manifest <offline manifest>; native W8 only, default paths preserved
offline_nz_prepack.representation: Offline v1 NZ files remain compatible. Const.value, output and consumer use the same physical FRACTAL_NZ[K1,N1,16,32] descriptor with logical origin_shape[N,K] and origin format ND; no public-Tensor storage_* normalization on the raw serialized value. Only audited immutable NZ Const nodes carry _out_shape_locked=true. Byte/hash/zero-padding and edge consistency are checked before save. Public inputs and WeightQuant consumers remain unlocked.
offline_nz_prepack.runtime: W8 weights reside in immutable offline NZ OM constants. The same symbolic AIR is specialized to separate static M16 and M64 OMs, without ATC dynamic_dims. Runner 1.14.0 selects by valid feature rows and shares prebound state/input/output buffers. Both OMs load before measurement with independent weight memory; their hashes and resident memory are reported.
offline_nz_prepack.validation: Host export and byte-exact NZ payload checks, static-OM compile/manifest contracts and fake-ACL C++ 16/64 dispatch/state tests only. Ascend310P ATC compilation, OM execution, numerical parity and latency of this static specialization are NOT_RUN.
offline_nz_prepack.diagnostic_probe: probe_draft_matmul_atc.py --bits 8 --projection tiny --prepack-weights --diagnose-prepack; locked prepacked dynamic16/64, locked prepacked static16, live-weight TransData dynamic positive control. Same values and math; live control intentionally has extra weight/scale inputs. Captures actual graph descriptors including _out_shape_locked on producer and WeightQuant.
offline_nz_prepack.diagnostic_scope: Real child-only ATC debug capture. Nonempty IGNORE_INFER_ERROR, including 0, is rejected. Merely mentioning a fusion pass in debug logs does not establish a fusion failure. Compile PASS still does not establish OM accuracy or performance.

shape_lock_reference.version_scope: upstream master, not verified as exact receiver binary source
shape_lock_reference.mechanism: ATTR_NAME_OUT_SHAPE_LOCKED is _out_shape_locked; InferShapePass skips only that node output re-inference; multi-batch Const-to-Data preserves other node attrs.

const_value_reference.version_scope: upstream reference, not verified as exact receiver binary source
const_value_reference.mechanism: CreateConstOp recreates output from raw value.GetTensorDesc(); preserve physical NZ there as well as on the outgoing edge.

draft_optimization_handoff.scope: Measured quantized Draft architecture review and custom-operator I/O, layout, precision and validation requirements; no new kernel implementation
draft_optimization_handoff.strict_policy: No new approximate arithmetic or relaxed numerical thresholds; operator-local correctness and ordinary model parity are separate gates
draft_optimization_handoff.promotion: Keep on development branch; target validation before merge to main
